study: 100-stock cash-cap study: 2000-2019 training, 2020-October 2026 testing; 90/10 stock/cash floor
training: Refit each slippage version independently from 2000 through 2019. Compare each state momentum candidate with the equal-weight 90 percent stock fallback using paired daily net-return differences, matching costs, and zero cash interest. Require positive conservative incremental return bound and at least 30 model-active holding days and 3 model-active scheduled rebalances. Required market exposure alone cannot qualify a policy.
initialization: Start each independent book at one million dollars with equal initial holdings across all 100 stocks. Hold until session index 20. Subsequently cap cash at 10 percent of post-cost equity at observed daily opens by adding any allocation shortfall equally across all stocks. Between scheduled rebalances buy equal-dollar top-ups only when cash exceeds its cap. Daily data cannot enforce an intraday cap. Terminal liquidation is exempt.
continuous: One continuous book from January 2020 through October 30, 2026, with no cross-year resets. Standalone 2020-2025 and 2026 windows restart independently. No rolling refits in this fixed-training sensitivity study.
rolling: Not requested for this study; the main HMM and expert assignments remain frozen after 2000-2019 training.
execution: Per-side slippage equals absolute actual shares traded times the version's fixed dollars/share. Reconstruct nominal quoted opens from Yahoo split-adjusted, dividend-unadjusted OHLC by reversing subsequent split factors through retrieval. Model equity uses dividend/split-adjusted OHLC; no duplicate dividend payments. Pay terminal liquidation.
sharpe: DGS10 annual percent converted to decimal, past-only forward filling and two-session publication lag. Prior-open annual yield accrues simple ACT/365 over the holding interval. Annualized Sharpe = sqrt(252) * mean(interval net return minus risk-free return) / sample standard deviation of interval excess returns. Fold initial entry costs into the first holding interval; undefined Sharpe is null.
cash: Keep separate DGS3MO lagged ACT/365 accrual on unencumbered cash; do not replace cash income with the DGS10 Sharpe reference.
limitations: Current selected 100-stock list has survivor and selection bias. Historical evaluation periods were already observed. Adjusted-price total returns and reconstructed quoted prices depend on vendor corporate-action accuracy; they are research approximations. Neither independent fitting nor lower execution costs guarantees a different selected policy or profitable results.
cash_limit_control: equal_weight_floor uses the same initial 100 percent holding, then targets 90 percent equal-weight stocks at each scheduled rebalance and uses identical daily floor top-ups, cost assumptions, and cash accrual. No HMM or momentum selection. The chart retains only both model versions and the zero-slippage full-stock buy-and-hold portfolio.
